ranking_principle: Prioritize missing bytes by epistemic unlock and ability to resolve a currently blocked proof gate, not by likelihood of producing a positive linguistic result.

targets: other demonstrably alternate-editorial Linear A transcription source
priority_order.minimum_useful_material: Exact byte-bearing transcription corpus or sufficient exact pages/files to establish an alternate-editorial source and precontent overlap.
priority_order.why_first: This is the only current lane capable of unlocking the external transcription-replication chain R3B_1 through R3B_4. All current mwenge/SigLA/R3C/R3D work shares or depends on existing transcription traditions and cannot substitute for it.
priority_order.success_next_step: Quarantine -> R3B0 acquisition receipt -> identity-only R3B1 overlap freeze before transcription-content inspection.

priority_order.minimum_useful_material: Enough exact files and preprocessing evidence to admit the frozen R3C-3 execution-input and normalization contracts.
priority_order.why_ranked_here: The scientific code and null models are already frozen and CI-validated; exact inputs would immediately permit a controlled reproduction/corrective audit without new method design.
priority_order.success_next_step: Quarantine -> R3C-3 execution-input receipt -> normalization canaries -> admitted normalized views -> frozen v0.1.2 execution.

targets: CSV/XLSX/ZIP/PY files linked from historical site
priority_order.minimum_useful_material: Archived site/export metadata capable of naming or recovering original project files and their provenance.
priority_order.why_ranked_here: This is not scientific evidence itself but may be the fastest institutional route to the P1 master list/code/data, because primary Stage-2 work cited blogs.ntu.edu.sg/linear-a/ as a Linear A Corpus site and current Blogs@NTU policy preserves an archive/unarchive mechanism in general.
priority_order.success_next_step: Quarantine site export/attachments -> project-site provenance receipt -> reconcile each attachment with R3C-3 exact-input contract.

priority_order.minimum_useful_material: Any author/institution-supplied method artifact that mechanically specifies which historical inscriptions were accepted and how 419 total / 336 syllabic documents were produced.
priority_order.why_ranked_here: Exact historical source identity is already proved but the published corpus-selection/parser scope remains unresolved; a genuine manifest or code could close that methodological gap without target-guided subset fitting.
priority_order.forbidden_shortcut: Search arbitrary subsets until 419 or downstream metrics match.
priority_order.success_next_step: Quarantine -> method-material provenance receipt -> replay selection/parser before any target comparison.

priority_order.minimum_useful_material: Byte-bearing XML/archive tied mechanically to the 2015 Digital Corpus lineage.
priority_order.why_ranked_here: It would strengthen format/digitization robustness and add a TEI-EpiDoc adapter lane, but its known Younger/GORILA lineage caps it at L1 and it cannot satisfy R3B external-replication requirements.
priority_order.success_next_step: Quarantine -> R3D receipt -> XML inventory/well-formedness -> EpiDoc capability inventory -> source-specific adapter freeze.

anti_bias_rules: Do not reorder sources because preliminary contents appear to favor or disfavor a linguistic hypothesis.
Do not inspect known JANUS candidate strings before the source-specific receipt permits scientific content inspection.
Do not call bibliographic metadata, a project webpage, README, filename or archive title 'source bytes'.
Do not promote a source's independence class merely because its serialization format differs.
Do not interpret absence from public search as proof that author-held or institutional material does not exist.
